customManagers.description: The Playwright image tag in the package.json scripts (the github-actions manager already reads the one in ci.yml); test/unit/playwright-image.test.mjs asserts all copies equal the pinned @playwright/test version

packageRules.description: Minor and patch bumps of the npm packages arrive together in one weekly pull request
Every GitHub Action arrives together in one weekly pull request

A Playwright or Chromium bump re-records every screenshot baseline (about 20 MB, spec 02), so the npm package and the Docker image tag move together in their own monthly pull request, never in the weekly groups; this rule comes after them to win (and group:playwrightMonorepo is ignored above, since it would split @playwright/test off)

packageRules.description: Mermaid draws the Automations flow charts, and its releases move their pixels (from 11.10 the node outlines are drawn as paths), so a bump comes in its own pull request, never in the weekly group, and fails the visual job until a person re-records the Automations baselines on its branch and adds a changeset (Renovate does neither). Unlike ApexCharts it is not frozen: its releases carry security fixes (docs/specs/07, As built)
vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 are installed at the same version, so a major bump of one is a major bump of both

A bump of a dev dependency changes nothing the household receives, so the label skips the changeset job (docs/specs/05); a runtime dependency (apexcharts, mermaid: bundled into the chunks the panel loads) does ship, so its pull requests are not labelled
A bump of an Action or of the Playwright image tag in the package.json scripts changes nothing the household receives either; same label
ApexCharts stays on 3.x: majors are skipped (4.x and 5.0.0 are MIT, 5.1.0 onward is under ApexCharts' own licence, per npm's licence field; docs/specs/production-grade-refactor.md)

ApexCharts is frozen at 3.45.2, not only held to 3.x: a minor or patch would change the charts the baselines in test/e2e/__screenshots__ pin pixel for pixel, and dist.test.mjs asserts the version. Unfreeze it on purpose, with a changeset and a visual check, never through the weekly group
license-checker-rseidelsohn 5 needs Node 24 and npm 11, and CI (the lint job) runs Node 22 and engines allows 22.19; stay on 4.x, as @types/node stays on 22, until the Node version is changed by hand
typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet; re-enable majors when it does
@types/node stays on the Node 22 that CI and the Playwright image run, until that is changed by hand
The Node version (setup-node, which :pinAllExceptPeerDependencies would pin to a patch release) and the runner image (ubuntu-24.04-arm) are chosen by hand; engines in package.json is left alone too
